author: David Bombal
description:
Have you heard of Shady AI? Unlike Shadow AI, which involves unapproved or unknown AI tools, Shady AI can involve tools your company has already approved.

The risk emerges when those tools gain access, integrations or capabilities beyond their intended purpose. An assistant approved to summarize documents could eventually read sensitive information and email it to someone who should never see it.

In the age of agentic AI, approved doesn't necessarily mean controlled.
